conventions: Headings: 0° = North, 90° = East, 180° = South, and 270° = West; clockwise in plan view, pointing out of the piece.
Coordinates [E,N,H] = [east,north,height] in metres. Source cells [column,row] increase east and south.
Display grid: X = source column − (0); Y = 2 − source row.
Slope is measured outward at the joining edge; the interior may differ. Offsets are + left and − right facing out of the tile edge.
Member offsets use the section origin. Counts distinguish physical channels / edge cuts / directed members; modes do not multiply channels.
Incoming flow enters this piece; outgoing flow leaves it. Letters identify boundary cards; source IDs remain the stable identities.
Not declared means no section origin or offset was authored. Its marker uses an actual member endpoint; the measured intersections remain authoritative.

purpose: Source-owned connection overview; software source checks do not establish physical or game behavior.

renderer.renderer: indexed S3D triangles with bilinear NAM FSH textures

camera_frame.basis: Actual model vertices, all required member endpoints, display anchors, and owned ground-grid corners

figure_typography.bold_usage: Piece and card titles, and section headings only

marker_order: source column, source row, edge rank South/North/West/East, boundary ID; groups by stable ID
supported_inputs: Registered canonical flat-reference pieces; one measured height per service group; explicit channel/cut associations; no free vertical placement or reflection

derivations.channels_and_cuts: Explicit source-backed associations; counts do not come from modes or directed-member counts
derivations.heading: degrees(atan2(outward_east,outward_north)) modulo 360; incoming travel tangent reversed
derivations.edge_slope_percent: 100 * travel grade for outgoing; -100 * travel grade for incoming; never an interior average
derivations.section_offset: Declared resolved offset from source tile-edge midpoint; null when no section offset was authored
derivations.member_offset: Measured endpoint minus declared section origin, dotted with tile-edge outward-left direction; null when the section origin is undeclared
derivations.display_anchor: Declared section origin, or one actual measured endpoint when no origin was authored, projected with the actual model camera; a display marker does not declare a section origin
